item.description:
Labwrk 1.1.9 improves polling performance, memory use, and connection reliability.
- Reused network connections and faster timestamp parsing reduce polling overhead. - Expired old pipeline notification history so memory does not grow with every pipeline seen over the app’s lifetime. - Prevented overlapping refreshes and cleaned up completed and canceled polling tasks. - Handled canceled requests quietly and prevented canceled token validation from installing a connection. - Stopped repeated refresh attempts after GitLab revokes a sign-in and preserved useful credential-storage errors. - Clamped invalid saved polling intervals to prevent excessive requests.
Verified with 76 passing tests and a production build.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.8 removes the dark rim from application branding and improves setup guidance.
- Corrected the clipboard artwork across the app icon catalog, macOS bundle icon, panel, Settings, About, and README. All sizes share the same full-canvas artwork with transparent corners and no black outer rim. - Renamed “Select Visible” to “Select All” in Projects. It selects all items matching the search; clear the search to select the complete list. - Added a step-by-step README setup guide with real application screenshots covering account connection, all five project scope modes, nested groups, saving selections, preferences, and updates. - Preserved the dynamic menu bar status indicators and existing project scope behavior.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.7 introduces clipboard branding and flexible project scope.
- Replaced the application icon with the supplied full-canvas clipboard artwork, preserving transparency without added black backgrounds or padding. Panel, Settings, and About headers load the supplied icon directly. - Added all five project scope modes: all projects, selected projects, selected groups, all except selected projects, and all except selected groups. - Added searchable project/group lists, inclusion/exclusion labels, scope counts, and Apply/Revert controls. Group selections include nested groups and newly discovered member projects. - Preserved saved project selections through migration. Scope consistently controls the pipeline panel, dynamic menu bar indicator, running count, and notifications. - Preserved the dynamic menu bar status behavior.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.
